cards.text:
【AUTO】 Bond/""Bang! On the Scene" Kokoro Tsurumaki" [Put 1 card from your hand into your waiting room] (When this card is played and placed on the stage, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose 1 ""Bang! On the Scene" Kokoro Tsurumaki" in your waiting room, and return it to your hand)

cards.text:

【ACT】 Brainstorm [(1) 【REST】 this card] Flip over 5 cards from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room. For each climax revealed among those cards, draw up to 1 card.
